evals.prompt: オーディオインターフェースのスペック照合、こないだ途中で止まってた気がする。今どこまで終わってるか確認して、再開に必要な対象 ids と Workflow の起動引数を JSON で resume-plan.json に書き出して。ワークフロー自体はまだ起動しないで。
evals.expected_output: Runs validate-results.js and outputs resume-plan.json containing ids matching nextIds in state.json, the scriptPath of workflow.js and the workDir
assertions: resume-plan.json exists and is valid JSON
The ids to resume match the nextIds in work/state.json as a set
The start arguments include the scriptPath of tools/verify/workflow.js and the workDir of tools/verify/work (absolute paths)
Verification was not run (the number of files in work/results/ has not increased since before the run)
The verified/incomplete counts in summary.md match the tallies in work/state.json

evals.prompt: スペック照合のレポートを最新の結果から作り直して report.md に置いて。ok/partial/wrong_page/failed の件数と相違検出の機種数も教えて。
evals.expected_output: Runs validate first, then generates report.md with build-report.js, with byStatus and the number of models with discrepancies matching the actual result files
assertions: report.md is generated at the given path
The fetch-status counts in report.md match byStatus in work/state.json
The counts reported in summary.md do not contradict the content of report.md
The number of models with detected discrepancies matches the actual result files (the count with non-empty mismatches)

evals.prompt: 照合できてない (failed) 機種の一覧をブランド別に集計して教えて。再挑戦するときのコマンドと引数も。結果は failed-summary.md に保存して。
evals.expected_output: Correctly tallies every failed model by brand, and shows the retry procedure with --retry-failed and the Workflow start arguments
assertions: failed-summary.md lists every failed model (matching failed in state.json)
The total of the per-brand tally matches the failed count in state.json
The retry procedure correctly shows validate-results.js --retry-failed (or via nextIds) and the Workflow start arguments
The failed results in work/results/ remain, neither moved aside nor deleted
